info.name: Numark NS4FX
info.author: Tomáš Bažant, Erik Puschendorf, Matthew Nicholson
info.description: Numark NS4FX mapping with support for LCD screens and 4 deck playback.

option.label: Enable Wheel on startup
option.description: When enabled, the jog wheels will be in vinyl/scratch mode by default. When disabled, they will be in pitch bend/nudge mode.

option.label: Shift+Load ejects track
option.description: When enabled, holding the SHIFT button and pressing LOAD will eject the track from the deck. If disabled, it will load and play the selected track.

option.label: Use effect only on active deck
option.description: When enabled, effects are only applied to the currently active deck (e.g., Deck 1 or 3). When disabled, effects are applied to both decks on that side (e.g., Deck 1 and 3).

option.label: Display VU from both decks
option.description: When enabled, the channel VU meters will display the left and right master output levels. When disabled, they will display the individual level for each active deck.

option.label: Select default performance pad mode after Mixxx startup
option.description: Sets the performance pad mode that is active when Mixxx starts.

option.label: Control stems with Slicer pads
option.description: When enabled, the 'Slicer' pad mode is replaced with a mode to control Stems (mute, volume, and quick effects).

option.label: Select the mode for EQ knobs
option.description: Select whether the EQ knobs should work normally or assign extended behaviour to them.

option.label: Control stems effects with EQ knobs
option.description: When enabled, the EQ knobs of decks 3 and 4 control stem effects of decks 1 and 2.

option.label: Use transport pads as hotcues in Hot Cue mode
option.description: When enabled, transport pads (CUE, START, BACK, FWD) will function as hotcues 5-8 when the pad mode is set to 'Hot Cue'.

option.label: Use transport pads as fadercuts in Fader Cuts mode
option.description: When enabled, transport pads (CUE, START, BACK, FWD) will function as fadercuts 5-8 when the pad mode is set to 'Fader Cuts'.

option.label: Exit slip mode after manual scratching
option.description: When the slip mode is on and you start manualy scratching, exit the slip mode after you finish the scratching so that the track can continue playing from the position where it originally should have been.

option.label: Use transport pads as scratch patterns in Scratch Banks mode
option.description: When enabled, transport pads (CUE, START, BACK, FWD) will function as scratch patterns 5-8 when the pad mode is set to 'Scratch Banks'.

option.label: Scratch speed (steps per beat)
option.description: Number of timer steps per beat for scratch patterns. 32 = 2 cycles/beat, 64 = 4 cycles/beat (default), 128 = 8 cycles/beat.

option.label: Control beat jump with Auto Loop second row pads
option.description: When enabled, transport pads (CUE, START, BACK, FWD) will control beat jump (back, dec, inc, fwd) when the pad mode is set to 'Auto Loop'.
